rounds.text: Shri Keshav Cements & Infra Ltd presents a concerning profile of deteriorating profitability and inefficient capital allocation. The company is currently generating negative returns, evidenced by an ROE of -7.28% [E8] and a median ROE over the last year of -7% [E26]. This poor performance is further highlighted by a trailing twelve-month profit growth of -204% [E18], signaling a sharp decline in earnings power. Despite these fundamental weaknesses, the stock is priced at a premium P/B of 2.01x, which exceeds the sector benchmark of 1.57x [E6]. The market’s expectations appear disconnected from reality, as price growth has outpaced profit growth by 167% [E50], and the stock is currently trading near the bottom of its 52-week range [E4]. Conceded: [E56] and [E57] indicate that the company has achieved 16% YoY sales growth and strong sales growth, though this has failed to translate into positive bottom-line results.
